eps.t: Awakening to the Joy of Painting
eps.ov: Life and priorities change for listless high schooler Yatora when he sees his classmate's painting and discovers an appreciation and talent for art.
eps.oa: تتغير حياة «ياتورا» وأولوياته، طالب الثانوية الفاتر، حين يرى لوحة زميل له فيكتشف في نفسه تذوقاً للفن وموهبة فيه.

eps.ov: Yatora enters the art club. Over summer break he takes part in special training to improve his skills after switching his college choice to art school.
eps.oa: يدخل «ياتورا» نادي الفنون. وفي العطلة الصيفية يشارك في تدريب خاص ليحسن مهارته بعد أن بدّل اختياره الجامعي إلى كلية الفنون.

eps.t: Prep School Debut of the Dead
eps.ov: Yatora joins Yuka for extra lessons at Tokyo Art Institute. He has an artistic breakthrough when visiting a museum with his strange new classmates.
eps.ta: ظهوري الأول في المدرسة التحضيرية، كالموتى الأحياء
eps.oa: ينضم «ياتورا» إلى «يوكا» في دروس إضافية في «معهد طوكيو للفنون». ويحقق انطلاقة فنية حين يزور متحفاً مع زملائه الجدد الغريبين.

eps.ov: TAI's night students join the intimidating afternoon classes to gear up for the next competition as the stress of art exams weigh on Yatora's friends.
eps.oa: ينضم طلاب الفترة المسائية في «معهد طوكيو للفنون» إلى دروس الظهيرة المهيبة استعداداً للمنافسة القادمة، بينما يثقل ضغط امتحانات الفنون على أصدقاء «ياتورا».

eps.t: Helpless Even If I Know What To Do
eps.ov: As exams near, Oba intensifies training. Yatora struggles to articulate abstract concepts, so Saeki encourages him to use a larger canvas for fun.
eps.ta: عاجز وإن عرفت ما عليّ فعله
eps.oa: مع اقتراب الامتحانات تشدد «أوبا» التدريب. ويجد «ياتورا» صعوبة في التعبير عن المفاهيم المجردة، فتشجعه «سايكي» على استعمال لوحة أكبر للمتعة.

eps.ov: Yatora experiments with various tools to find a secret weapon that will boost his art while exam stress begins to wear on the students' health.
eps.oa: يجرب «ياتورا» أدوات شتى بحثاً عن سلاح سري يرتقي بفنه، بينما يبدأ ضغط الامتحانات ينال من صحة الطلاب.

eps.t: The Start of the First Exam
eps.ov: Oba tells Yatora his weakness, which sends him spiraling. But a heart-to-heart with a close friend reignites his confidence as the first exam begins!
The first exam subject is "self-portrait." A mishap gives Yatora the hint he needs; Oba takes the class to a museum before exam results are announced.
Three move on to the second exam, including Yatora, who must master "color." Yatora worries after Yuka gets a seedy job and refuses to go to art school.
Yuka and Yatora head to Odawara and bare their souls and bodies, hoping to overcome their personal challenges with art and their surrounding fears.

eps.t: The Start of the Second Exam
eps.ov: After drawing his own body, Yatora is ready for the second exam: a nude model. But when his health declines from stress, Oba offers a secret weapon.

eps.t: When I Started to be Dyed in Color
eps.ov: The second exam is in full swing. Yatora struggles with illness and an unclear theme when sudden inspiration delivers answers and a final secret weapon.
